flow.title: A glaze firing
flow.meta: Left to right; scrolls sideways at phone width
flow.label: A glaze firing, from bisque to inspection
flow.src:
flowchart LR
  B[Bisque ware] --> G[Dip in glaze]
  G --> W{Feet wiped?}
  W -- no --> G
  W -- yes --> L[Load the kiln]
  L --> F[Fire to cone 6]
  F --> C[Cool closed]
  C --> I[Inspect]
  I -->|crazing| G
  class I done
  class F hot
  classDef done fill:%ok/18%,stroke:%ok%,color:%ink%
  classDef hot fill:%warn/18%,stroke:%warn%,color:%ink%

seq.title: The controller during a firing
seq.label: Potter, kiln controller and log during a firing
seq.src:
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant P as Potter
  participant K as Kiln controller
  participant L as Firing log
  P->>K: Start schedule (cone 6, hold 10 min)
  K-->>P: Ramping at 150 °C an hour
  Note over K: Hold at 1222 °C
  K->>L: Peak and hold reached
  P->>L: Cone pack result
